prompt: Generate one concise semantic description of an unspecified topic. Return only the description.
success_rule: A cell is operational only if both calls have transport_success=true and visible_text_success=true.
decision_rule: If one or more cells are operational, choose the operational cell with the smallest max_tokens, breaking ties by matrix order, freeze it prospectively in a separate change, and restart EVIDENCE_AFTER after that change lands. If no cell is operational, record no eligible Ox Alpha substrate.
